title: Model Selection Tradeoffs — Maintain a Portfolio, Not a Permanent Winner
key_insight: Use an internal contract and evaluation suite so candidates can be retested and swapped. Route by task, risk, and budget when several models remain useful.
body:
## Maintain a Portfolio, Not a Permanent Winner

Provider prices, model versions, and workloads change. A choice made once becomes stale.

Use an internal contract and evaluation suite so candidates can be retested and swapped. Route by task, risk, and budget when several models remain useful.

Account for switching cost and correlated failures. Two endpoints backed by the same infrastructure may not be a real fallback.
common_mistakes: Parameter count alone selects the best deployment.
Hosted and local models have identical privacy responsibilities.
A theoretical speedup guarantees lower production tail latency.
mini_exercise: Draw “Maintain a Portfolio, Not a Permanent Winner” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Real systems choose among local, hosted, small, and large models by workload-specific constraints.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Maintain a Portfolio, Not a Permanent Winner” to explain Model Selection Tradeoffs plainly.
